communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Connecticut Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

Copies of all legal services invoices and related billing records paid, received, or incurred by Thomaston Public Schools and/or the Thomaston Board of Education from July 1, 2025, through November 11, 2026.

This request includes all legal services provided to or on behalf of Thomaston Public Schools, the Thomaston Board of Education, the superintendent's office, district administration, individual schools, and any other department, office, employee, or representative acting in an official capacity.

This request is intended to encompass all legal services, regardless of their nature, purpose, subject matter, funding source, or the attorney or law firm providing the services. This includes, but is not limited to, general counsel, personnel and employment matters, labor relations, collective bargaining, grievances, litigation, investigations, contracts, special education, regulatory compliance, governance, and any other legal matters. These examples are illustrative and do not limit the scope of this request.

I specifically request complete, itemized invoices and billing statements, including, to the extent maintained, dates of service, descriptions of services performed, attorney or staff names, hours billed, hourly rates, expenses, and amounts charged. This request includes invoices that remain unpaid, as well as those already paid, and invoices paid through insurance, other governmental entities, or alternative funding arrangements, to the extent such records are maintained by the district.

I recognize that certain information may be protected by attorney-client privilege or another applicable exemption under Connecticut law. I am not requesting disclosure of privileged communications or legally exempt information. Where specific portions of an invoice are exempt, I request that only those portions be redacted and that all remaining nonexempt information be provided. Please do not withhold entire invoices solely because they contain some exempt information.

I also request that, if possible and pursuant to Conn. Gen. Stat. § 1-212(d), fees be waived as I believe this request is in the public interest and not made for commercial gain. The requested documents will be made available to the public at MuckRock.com.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 4 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Sam Bellford

To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

Military service records for subject below;
Name: Robert L. Cole,   
Branch: United States Army
DOB: November 10, 1931
Dates of Service: Approx yrs 1950 to 1974 

Please provide the following military service information:
1. copy of Meritorious Service Medal citations
2. copy of Bronze star medal award citations 
3. Copy of Army Commendation award citations
4. List of awards, date of ranks, date of discharge 
5.  Section II Military Education/ training courses 
6.  History of Assignments
7. Certificate of achievement award
8. Copy of silver star medal award citation 
Vietnam War MACVSOG 
Redact per 5 U.S.C. § 552(b)(6).
I request hard copies of paperwork in the file showing this information.
Please mail hardcopies to:
MUCKROCK NEWS Dept MR#
263 HUNTINGTON AVE
BOSTON, MA 02115

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Eric Bradley
